name: realizing a requirement
from: An accepted requirement, distributed, and a builder who will meet an adjacent requirement it can meet if meeting this one turns out to be hard — and who will not notice doing so.
to: The requirement met as stated, or reported back as unrealizable as stated. Not a third thing that was easier and got called the same name.
cost: The building. And, in the case that matters, the builder stopping to report a difficulty at the moment continuing is cheaper and reporting feels like failure — which is a real cost and is why this needs a duty rather than an encouragement.
